verses.saheeh: By the star when it descends,
verses.khattab: By the stars when they fade away
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the Star — the constellation Pleiades (al-thurayya) — when it sets, [when] it disappears,
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai taare ki jabke woh guroob hua

verses.saheeh: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
verses.khattab: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray
verses.jalalayn: ﻿your companion, Muhammad (s), may God bless him and grant him peace, has neither gone astray, from the path of guidance, nor has he erred, nor has he engaged in error (al-ghayy is ignorance that results from a false belief);
verses.romanUrdu: Tumhara rafeeq(companion) na bhatka hai na behka(deluded) hai

verses.saheeh: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
verses.khattab: Nor does he speak of his own whims
verses.jalalayn: ﻿nor does he, in regard to what he brings you, speak out of [his own] desire, [out of] the whims of his soul.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh apni khwaish-e-nafs se nahin bolta

verses.saheeh: It is not but a revelation revealed,
verses.khattab: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿It is but a revelation that is revealed, to him,
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to ek wahee (Inspiration /revelation) hai jo uspar nazil ki jati hai

verses.saheeh: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
verses.khattab: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power
verses.jalalayn: ﻿it is, taught to him by, an angel, one of awesome power,
verses.romanUrdu: Usey zabardast quwwat waley ne taleem di hai

verses.saheeh: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
verses.khattab: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form
verses.jalalayn: ﻿possessed of vigour, of strength and might (or [alternatively it, dhū mirratin, means] possessed of a beautiful appearance), namely, Gabriel, peace be upon him; and he stood upright, he settled,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo bada sahib-e-hikmat hai

verses.saheeh: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
verses.khattab: while on the highest point above the horizon
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when he was on the highest horizon, the horizon of the sun, that is to say, at the place from which it rises, in the form in which he [Gabriel] was created, so that the Prophet (s) saw him; he [the Prophet] had been at [Mount] Hirā’, where Gabriel had obscured the entire horizon to the west. The Prophet fell down swooning, after he had asked him [Gabriel] to show himself to him in the form in which he was created. Thus Gabriel had made a tryst with him at Hirā’, where he came down to him in human form.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh saamne aa khada hua jabke woh balaii ufuq par tha(highest part of the horizon)

verses.saheeh: Then he approached and descended
verses.khattab: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then he drew near, he came close to him, and drew closer still,
verses.romanUrdu: Phir kareeb aaya aur upar muallak ho gaya.(approached and descended)

verses.saheeh: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
verses.khattab: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less
verses.jalalayn: ﻿until he was, from him [the Prophet], within the length of two bows away or [even] nearer, than that, until he [the Prophet] had regained consciousness and his fright had subsided,
verses.romanUrdu: Yahan tak ke do kamano (bow lengths) ke barabar ya issey kuch kam faasla reh gaya

verses.saheeh: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
verses.khattab: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿whereat He, [God] exalted be He, revealed to His servant, Gabriel, what he, Gabriel, revealed, to the Prophet (s); the thing being revealed is not mentioned [explicitly] in exaltation of its [great] status.
verses.romanUrdu: Tab usne Allah ke banday ko wahee (revelation) pahunchayi jo wahee (revelation) bhi usey pahunchani thi

verses.saheeh: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
verses.khattab: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The heart, the heart of the Prophet, did not deny (read khadhaba or kadhdhaba) what he saw, with his own eyes of the image of Gabriel.
verses.romanUrdu: Nazar ne jo kuch dekha, dil ne usmein jhoot na milaya

verses.saheeh: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
verses.khattab: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Will you then dispute with him, will you [then] argue with him and [hope to] overwhelm him, concerning what he saw? — an address to the idolaters who denied the Prophet’s (s) vision of Gabriel.

wbw.translation: Then will you dispute with him

verses.romanUrdu: Ab kya tum us cheez par ussey jhagadte ho jisey woh aankhon se dekhta hai

verses.saheeh: And he certainly saw him in another descent
verses.khattab: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily he saw him, in his [true] image, another time,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ek martaba phir usney

verses.saheeh: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
verses.khattab: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿by the Lote-tree of the Ultimate Boundary, when he was carried on the night journey [up] through the heavens — this [lote-tree] is a nabk thorn-tree [that lies] to the right of the Throne (‘arsh), [the tree] beyond which no angel or any other being pass;
verses.romanUrdu: Sidratul muntaha ke paas usko (Angel Gibriel) dekha

verses.saheeh: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
verses.khattab: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿near which is the Garden of the Retreat, to which the angels, the spirits of martyrs and the pious retreat;
verses.romanUrdu: Jahan paas hi jannat-ul-maawa hai

verses.saheeh: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
verses.khattab: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when there shrouded the Lote-tree that which shrouded [it], of flying creatures and other [beings] (idh, ‘when’, is operated by ra’āhu, ‘he saw him’),
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt sidrah par chaa raha tha jo kuch ke chaa raha tha

verses.saheeh: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
verses.khattab: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The eye did not swerve, on the part of the Prophet (s), nor did it go beyond [the bounds], that is to say, his gaze did not turn away from the object of vision designated for it, nor did it go beyond that [object] on that night.
verses.romanUrdu: Nigaah na chundhyayi (waver / swerve) na hadd se mutajawiz (transgress) hui

verses.uthmani: لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: لَقَدْ رَاٰى مِنْ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرٰى
verses.saheeh: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.khattab: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Verily he saw, in it, some of the greatest signs of his Lord, [some of] the most awesome [of these signs]. He thus saw from among the marvels of the Realm (malakūt) a green drape (rafraf) that obscured the [entire] horizon of the heaven and Gabriel with his six hundred wings.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur usney apne Rubb ki badi badi nishaniyan dekhi

verses.saheeh: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
verses.khattab: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have you considered al-Lāt and al-‘Uzzā,
verses.romanUrdu: Ab zara batao , tumne kabhi is Laat aur is Uzza (names of pagan idols)

verses.saheeh: And Manat, the third - the other one?
verses.khattab: and the third one, Manât, as well
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Manāt, the third, of the preceding two, the other? (al-ukhrā, a derogatory qualification of the third one). These were stone idols which the idolaters worshipped and which they claimed interceded for them with God (the first direct object of a-fa-ra’aytum, ‘have you seen’, is al-Lāt and what has been supplemented thereto; the second [direct object] has been omitted). The meaning then is, ‘Inform Me: do these idols have the power over anything, such that you worship them besides God Who has the power over all that has been mentioned?’ And because of their assertion also that the angels were God’s daughters, despite their aversion to daughters, the following was revealed:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tisri (third) ek aur devi Manaat ki haqeeqat par kuch gaur bhi kiya

verses.saheeh: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
verses.khattab: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Are you to have males, and He females?
verses.romanUrdu: Kya betay (sons) tumhare liye hain aur betiyan (daughters) khuda ke liye

verses.saheeh: That, then, is an unjust division.
verses.khattab: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That, then, would indeed be an unfair division! (dīzān, ‘unfair’, derives from dāzahu, yadīzuhu, to mean: ‘he wronged him’, ‘he was unjust to him’).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh to badi dhandhli (unjust/unfair) ki taqseem hui

verses.uthmani: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءٞ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: اِنْ هِىَ اِلَّاۤ اَسْمَاۤءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوْهَاۤ اَنْتُمْ وَاٰبَاۤؤُكُمْ مَّاۤ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطٰنٍ ۗ اِنْ يَّتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْاَنْفُسُ ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَهُمْ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمُ الْهُدٰى ۗ
verses.transliteration: in hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala allahu biha min sultanin in yattabi'oona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda
verses.saheeh: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
verses.khattab: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord
verses.jalalayn: ﻿These, that is, the mentioned [deities], are nothing but names which you have named, by which you have named, you and your fathers, idols that you worship. God has not revealed any warrant, [any] proof or evidence, for them, that is to say, [for] the worship of them. They follow nothing but conjecture, in their worship of them, and that which [ignoble] souls desire, of that which Satan adorned for them, that they may intercede for them before God, exalted be He, even though guidance has already come to them from their Lord, by the tongue of the Prophet (s), with definitive proof; yet they do not desist from their ways.
verses.romanUrdu: Darasal yeh kuch nahin hain magar bas chandh naam jo tumne aur tumhare baap dada ne rakh liye hain. Allah ne inke liye koi sanad nazil nahin ki. Haqeeat yeh hai ke log mehez weham-o-gumaan ki pairvi kar rahey hain aur khwahishaat-e-nafs ke mureed bane huey hain, halanke unke Rubb ki taraf se unke paas hidayat aa chuki hai

verses.saheeh: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
verses.khattab: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or shall man, that is, shall every human being among them, have whatever he wishes for?, such as [their wish] that the idols intercede for them. [No!] It is not so.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya insaan jo kuch chaahe uske liye wahi haqq hai

verses.saheeh: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.khattab: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Yet to God belong the Hereafter and the former [life], that is to say, [the life of] the world, and so nothing comes to pass in them except what He, exalted, wills.
verses.romanUrdu: Duniya aur aakhirat ka maalik to Allah hi hai

verses.uthmani: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: ۞ وَكَمْ مِّنْ مَّلَكٍ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ لَا تُغْنِىْ شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْــًٔــا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اَنْ يَّأْذَنَ اللّٰهُ لِمَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ وَيَرْضٰى
verses.transliteration: wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafa'atuhum shayan illa min ba'di an yathana allahu liman yashao wayarda
verses.saheeh: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
verses.khattab: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And how many an angel, that is to say, many an angel, there is in the heavens, and how honoured they are in God’s sight [but], whose intercession cannot avail in any way except after God gives permission, to them for this [intercession], for whomever He wills, of His servants, and, with whom, He is satisfied, because of His saying: and they do not intercede except for him with whom He is satisfied [Q. 21:28]. It is also well-known that it [intercession] cannot be forthcoming from them except after permission for it has been granted: who is there that shall intercede with Him save with His leave [Q. 2:255].
verses.romanUrdu: Aasmano mein kitne hi farishte maujood hain, un ki shafaat (intercession) kuch bhi kaam nahin aa sakti jab tak ke Allah kisi aisey shaks ke haqq mein uski ijazat na dey jiske liye woh koi arzdaasht (plea) sunna chahe aur usko pasand karey

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّوْنَ الْمَلٰۤٮِٕكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْاُنْثٰى
verses.transliteration: inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha
verses.saheeh: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
verses.khattab: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels the names of females, for they say: ‘They are God’s daughters’.
verses.romanUrdu: Magar jo log aakhirat ko nahin maante woh farishton ko deviyon (godess) ke naamo se mausoom karte hain

verses.uthmani: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـٔٗا
verses.indopak: وَمَا لَهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۗ اِنْ يَّتَّبِعُوْنَ اِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۚ وَاِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِىْ مِنَ الْحَـقِّ شَيْـًٔـا ۚ
verses.transliteration: wama lahum bihi min 'ilmin in yattabi'oona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan
verses.saheeh: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
verses.khattab: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But they do not have any knowledge thereof, of this claim. They follow, in this [respect], nothing but conjecture, which they have conjured up, and indeed conjecture can never substitute for the truth, that is to say, when it comes to acquiring knowledge of that which one is required to have knowledge of.
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke is maamle ka koi ilm (knowledge) unhein haasil nahin hai. Woh mehez gumaan ki pairvi kar rahey hain, aur gumaan haqq ki jagah kuch bhi kaam nahin de sakta

verses.uthmani: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
verses.indopak: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْ مَّنْ تَوَلّٰى ۙ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ اِلَّا الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا ۗ
verses.transliteration: faa'rid 'an man tawalla 'an thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya
verses.saheeh: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
verses.khattab: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So shun him who turns away from Our Remembrance, that is, [from] the Qur'an, and desires nothing but the life of this world — this was [revealed] before the command to struggle [against the disbelievers].
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey Nabi, jo shaks hamarey zikr se mooh pherta hai, aur duniya ki zindagi ke siwa jise kuch matloob nahin hai, usey uske haal par chodh do

verses.uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
verses.indopak: ذٰلِكَ مَبْلَـغُهُمْ مِّنَ الْعِلْمِ ۗ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖ ۙ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدٰى
verses.transliteration: <u>tha</u>lika mablaghuhum mina al'ilmi inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman <u>d</u>alla 'an sabeelihi wahuwa a'lamu bimani ihtad<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
verses.khattab: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That, namely, the desire of this world, is the full extent of their knowledge, that is, the limit of their knowledge, namely, that they have preferred this life to [that of] the Hereafter. Truly your Lord knows best those who have strayed from His way, and He knows best those who are [rightly] guided: He has knowledge of both and will requite both.
verses.romanUrdu: In logon ka mablag-e-ilm (utmost of their knowledge) bas yahi kuch hai, yeh baat tera Rubb hi zyada jaanta hai ke uske raaste se kaun bhatak gaya hai aur kaun seedhe raaste par hai

verses.uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى
verses.indopak: وَلِلّٰهِ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ۙ لِيَجْزِىَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسَاۤءُوْا بِمَا عَمِلُوْا وَيَجْزِىَ الَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا بِالْحُسْنٰى ۚ
verses.transliteration: walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima 'amiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna
verses.saheeh: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
verses.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And to God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that is, He owns [all of] that, among which [also] are the misguided one and the [rightly] guided one, leading astray whomever He will and guiding whomever He will, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done, by way of idolatry and otherwise, and reward those who are virtuous, by [their] affirmation of [God’s] Oneness and other acts of obedience, with the best [reward], namely, Paradise. He points out ‘the virtuous’ as being:
verses.romanUrdu: Aur zameen aur aasmaano ki har cheez ka maalik Allah hi hai. Taa-ke Allah burayi karne waalon ko unke amal ka badla de aur un logon ko acchi jaza se nawaze jinhon ne neik rawayya ikhtiyar kiya hai

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةٞ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡ ۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.indopak: اَلَّذِيْنَ يَجْتَنِبُوْنَ كَبٰۤٮِٕرَ الْاِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ اِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۙ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۗ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ اِذْ اَنْشَاَكُمْ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ وَاِذْ اَنْتُمْ اَجِنَّةٌ فِىْ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ ۚ فَلَا تُزَكُّوْۤا اَنْفُسَكُمْ ۗ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقٰى
verses.transliteration: allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasi'u almaghfirati huwa a'lamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimani ittaqa
verses.saheeh: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
verses.khattab: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Those who avoid grave sins and abominations, excepting lesser offences, that is, minor sins, such as a look, a kiss or a touch (this constitutes a discontinuous exception, in other words the meaning is: but lesser offences are forgiven by the avoidance of grave sins). Truly your Lord is of vast forgiveness, for such [lesser sins] and for accepting repentance. The following was revealed regarding those who used to say, ‘[What of] our prayers, our fasting, and our pilgrimage!’. He knows you best [from the time] when He produced you from the earth, that is to say, [when] He created your father Adam from dust, and when you were hidden [fetuses] (ajinna is the plural of janīn) in the bellies of your mothers. So do not claim purity for yourselves, do not praise yourselves, that is, in admiration; but [if it is done] in recognition of [God’s] grace, then that is fine. He knows best those who are God-fearing.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo badey badey gunahon aur khule khule qabeeh afaal (shameful deeds) se parheiz karte hain, illa yeh ke kuch kasoor unse sarzad ho jaye. Bila shubhah tere Rubb ka daaman-e-magfirat bahut waseeh hai. Woh tumhein us waqt se khoob jaanta hai jab usne zameen se tumhein paida kiya, aur jab tum apni maaon (mothers) ke paiton (wombs) mein abhi janin (fetuses) hi thay. Pas apne nafs ki paaki ke daawe na karo. Wahi behtar jaanta hai ke waqai muttaqi kaun hai

verses.saheeh: Have you seen the one who turned away
verses.khattab: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Did you see him who turned away, from faith — that is, [the one who] recanted when he was derided for it. He said, ‘But I fear the punishment of God!’. But when the one deriding him guaranteed him that he would bear God’s chastisement for him, provided that he reverted to his [former] idolatry, and he then gave him a stated sum money, he reverted —
verses.romanUrdu: Phir aey Nabi, tumne us shaks ko bhi dekha jo raah-e-khuda se phir gaya

verses.saheeh: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
verses.khattab: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and gave a little, of the stated sum of money, and was then grudging?, refrained from [giving] the remainder (akdā derives from al-kudya, earth that is hard as rock and which prevents the well-digger from digging through when he hits it).
verses.romanUrdu: Aur thoda sa de kar ruk gaya

verses.saheeh: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
verses.khattab: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Does he possess knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?, [and therefore] from among such [knowledge] he is able to know that another person may bear the chastisement of the Hereafter for him? No! This was al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra, or someone else (the sentence beginning with a-‘indahu, ‘does he possess’, is the second object of the a-ra’ayta, ‘have you seen’, which has the significance of ‘inform Me!’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya uske paas gaib ka ilm hai ke woh haqeeqat ko dekh raha hai

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.indopak: اَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِىْ صُحُفِ مُوْسٰى ۙ
verses.transliteration: am lam yunabba bim<u>a</u> fee <u>s</u>u<u>h</u>ufi moos<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
verses.khattab: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or (am means bal) has he not been informed of what is in the scrolls of Moses, the books of the Torah, or scrolls before it,
verses.romanUrdu: Kya usey un baaton ki koi khabar nahin pahunchi jo moosa ke sahifon

verses.saheeh: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
verses.khattab: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and, the scrolls of, Abraham who fulfilled [his summons], [he who] completed what he had been charged with, as in: And when his Lord tested Abraham with certain words and he fulfilled them [Q. 2:124] (the explication of mā, ‘what’, is [the following]):
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us Ibrahim ke sahifon mein bayan hui hai jisne wafa ka haqq ada kar diya

verses.indopak: اَ لَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِّزْرَ اُخْرٰى ۙ
verses.saheeh: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
verses.khattab: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another
verses.jalalayn: ﻿that no burdened soul shall bear the burden of another (an, ‘that’, has been softened in place of the hardened form), in other words, no soul shall bear [responsibility for] the sins of another;
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ke koi bojh uthane wala dusre ka bojh nahin uthayega

verses.uthmani: وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَاَنْ لَّيْسَ لِلْاِنْسَانِ اِلَّا مَا سَعٰى ۙ
verses.transliteration: waan laysa lilins<u>a</u>ni ill<u>a</u> m<u>a</u> sa'<u>a</u>
verses.saheeh: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
verses.khattab: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that (wa-an, to be understood as wa-annahu) man shall have only what he [himself] strives for, of good [deeds], and so he shall not have anything of [the reward for] good [deeds] striven for by another;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke Insaan ke liye kuch nahin hai magar woh jiski usne saii(koshish /Strive) ki hai

verses.saheeh: And that his effort is going to be seen -
verses.khattab: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that his endeavour will be seen, it will be inspected in the Hereafter,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke uski saii (koshih/strive/effort) anqareeb dekhi jayegi

verses.saheeh: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
verses.khattab: then they will be fully rewarded
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward, the most perfect [reward] (one may say jazaytuhu sa‘yahu or [jazaytuhu] bi-sa‘yihi [to mean the same thing]),

wbw.translation: he will be recompensed for it

verses.romanUrdu: Aur uski puri jaza use di jayegi

verses.saheeh: And that to your Lord is the finality
verses.khattab: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that (read wa-anna as a supplement; it is also read wa-inna as the beginning of a new sentence; and the same applies to what comes after it, in which case, according to this second [reading], these [inna statements] no longer form part of the content of all that is ‘in the scrolls’) the ultimate end, the return and the destination after death, is toward your Lord, whereat He will requite them;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke aakhir-e-kaar pahunchna tere Rubb hi ke paas hai

verses.saheeh: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
verses.khattab: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that it is He Who makes to laugh, whomever He will He makes joyous, and makes to weep, whomever He will He makes him sorrowful,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke usi ne hasaya aur usi ne rulaya

verses.saheeh: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
verses.khattab: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that it is He Who brings death, in this world, and gives life, for resurrection,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke usi ne maut di aur usi ne zindagi bakshi

verses.saheeh: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
verses.khattab: And He created the pairs—males and females—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that He [Himself] creates the two spouses, the two kinds, the male and the female,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke usi ne narr (male) aur maada (female) ka joda paida kiya

verses.saheeh: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.khattab: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.jalalayn: ﻿from a drop [of semen] once it is emitted, [once] it is poured forth into the womb,
verses.romanUrdu: Ek boond (sperm-drop) se jab woh tapkayi jati hai

verses.saheeh: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
verses.khattab: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that with Him rests the second genesis (read al-nashā’ata, or al-nash’ata), the other creation, for the Resurrection, after the first creation,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke dusri zindagi bakshna bhi usi ke zimme hai

verses.saheeh: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
verses.khattab: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that it is He Who enriches, people by [granting them] sufficient wealth, and grants possessions, [He Who] gives that wealth that is enjoyed as property,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke usi ne gani (enriches) kiya aur jaidad bakshi

verses.saheeh: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
verses.khattab: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that it is He Who is the Lord of Sirius — this is a star [lying] beyond [the constellation of] Gemini, which was worshipped in the time of pagandom (jāhiliyya);
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke wahi sheraa (Sirius / mighty star) ka Rubb hai

verses.saheeh: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
verses.khattab: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and that He destroyed former ‘Ād (‘Ādan al-ūlā: a variant reading elides the nunation with the [following] lām [sc. ‘Āda’l-ūlā]; this [former one] refers to the people of ‘Ād, while the second [‘Ād] is that of the people of Sālih)
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh ke usi ne Aad-e-oola (people of Aad) ko halaak kiya

verses.saheeh: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
verses.khattab: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and Thamūd (wa-Thamūda: may be declined, as the name of their forefather, or left as a diptote, being the name of the tribe; it is a supplement to ‘Ādan) sparing not, a single one of them;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur samood ko aisa mitaya ke unmein se kisi ko baaki na choda

verses.uthmani: وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
verses.indopak: وَقَوْمَ نُوْحٍ مِّنْ قَبْلُ ۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا هُمْ اَظْلَمَ وَاَطْغٰى ۗ
verses.transliteration: waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha
verses.saheeh: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
verses.khattab: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the people of Noah before that, that is to say, before ‘Ād and Thamūd, We [also] destroyed them; indeed they were more unjust and more insolent, than ‘Ād and Thamūd, because of the long time that Noah remained among them: and he remained among them a thousand-less-fifty years [Q. 29:14], for they, despite their disbelief in him, would [still] harm him and assault him;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur unse pehle qaum-e-Nooh ko tabaah kiya kyunke woh thay hi sakht zaalim-o-sarkash log

verses.saheeh: And the overturned towns He hurled down
verses.khattab: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and the Deviant [cities], namely, the cities of the people of Lot, He overturned, He hurled them down to the earth after lifting them up to the heaven upside down, by commanding Gabriel to do this;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur aundhi girne wali bastiyon ko utha phenka. (Qaum-e-Lut)

verses.saheeh: And covered them by that which He covered.
verses.khattab: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿so that there covered them, of rocks afterwards, that which covered [them]: this is [purposely] left vague in order to inspire terror; in [sūrat] Hūd [it is stated]: We made their uppermost the nethermost, and We rained upon them stones of baked clay [Q. 11:82].
verses.romanUrdu: Phir chaa diya unpar woh kuch jo (tum jaante hi ho ke) kya chaa diya

verses.saheeh: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
verses.khattab: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then which of the bounties of your Lord, [which of] His graces, [graces] which indicate His Oneness and power, do you dispute?, do you have doubt about, O man, or deny?
verses.romanUrdu: Pas aey mukhatib, apne Rubb ki kin kin niyamaton mein tu shakk karega

verses.saheeh: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
verses.khattab: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, Muhammad (s), is a warner, [in the tradition] of the warners of old, of their kind, that is to say, he is a messenger like messengers before him, sent to you just as they were sent to their peoples.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh ek tambeeh (warning) hai pehle aaye huye tambihaat(warnings) mein se

verses.saheeh: The Approaching Day has approached.
verses.khattab: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The Impending [Hour] is imminent: the Resurrection is near at hand.
verses.romanUrdu: Aane wali ghadi qareeb aa lagi hai

verses.uthmani: لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.indopak: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ كَاشِفَةٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: laysa laha min dooni allahi kashifatun
verses.saheeh: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
verses.khattab: None but Allah can disclose it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿None, [no] soul, besides God can disclose it, that is to say, only He can disclose it and manifest it, as where He says: He alone shall reveal it, at its proper time [Q. 7:187].
verses.romanUrdu: Allah ke siwa koi usko hatane wala nahin

verses.saheeh: Then at this statement do you wonder?
verses.khattab: Do you find this revelation astonishing
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Do you then marvel, in denial, at this discourse, the Qur'an,
verses.romanUrdu: Ab kya yahi woh baatein hain jinpar tum izhaar- e-taajub karte ho

verses.saheeh: And you laugh and do not weep
verses.khattab: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and laugh, mockingly, and not weep, when you hear its Promise and Threat,
verses.romanUrdu: Hanste(laugh) ho aur rotey (weep) nahin ho

verses.saheeh: While you are proudly sporting?
verses.khattab: while persisting in heedlessness
verses.jalalayn: ﻿while you remain oblivious?, unmindful and heedless of what is required of you.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur gaa (singing) bajaa kar inhein taalte ho

verses.saheeh: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
verses.khattab: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So prostrate to God, Who created you, and worship Him!, and do not prostrate to idols, nor worship them.
verses.romanUrdu: Jhuk jao Allah ke aagey aur bandagi baja laaoo (ayat-e-sajda)
